reviews.text: Well done Amelia. Beautiful approach and above all sensitive and respectful with animals. I witnessed an encounter with a friend's dog 🐕, at a nearby park. …
In just a few sessions, we resolved a long-standing problem with our dog. Great professionalism and empathy. Recommended.
Professionalism, seriousness and love for work.

Negative experience, rude trainer, careless, uninterested, and sloppy.
She even showed up half an hour late for the first meeting, as if we were all free in life.
Maybe not all of them are like this, but the one I had was truly awful.
I strongly advise against it. Milan is crowded, and there are much better and cheaper services.

I had the pleasure of taking some individual lessons with Amelia from Puppyness, along with my dachshund Gennarino. We held the sessions both at home and outdoors, and I had a great time.

Amelia is very knowledgeable and has a kind and respectful approach to dogs. During the lessons, she helped me better understand Gennarino and improve our communication.

I recommend Puppyness to anyone looking for professional and attentive support in training their dog.

Hello everyone, first of all. For me and my dog ​​Destiny, it was the first experience of this kind and it was wonderfully beautiful. Amelia, with her expertise, her precious advice, her energy and her smiles, made ours not just a "simple" walk but a beautiful journey 🐶❤️🐶 …

I sincerely thank Amelia for giving me a wonderful, emotional journey with my dog...
I've always had dogs, but I felt the need to understand and respect them more, giving them what they truly needed, no longer forcing them to conform solely to my habits. I wanted to give them a life worthy of a dog... and I've begun a beautiful journey of discovery into their world... and the bond I'm developing with my dog ​​is wonderful, indescribable.
I strongly advise anyone who thinks they know it all to take a chance...
Elena

Amelia is a serious professional, she loves her job, and she pays attention to even the smallest details that many of us would miss.
I received an evaluation from her of my 7-year-old German Shepherd and his interaction with other dogs.
Her work demonstrates a profound knowledge of ethology.
What a wonderful experience!! My lady and I were welcomed by Amelia, a truly competent and capable person!! She's not just a dog trainer but a truly loving person.
